en.headline: Veteran stock commentator Louie Shum dies at 66
en.dek: Former Sincere Securities chief Louie Shum Chun-ying collapsed near a taxi rank in Wan Chai and died on Saturday night at Ruttonjee Hospital, his family confirmed.
body: Veteran Hong Kong stock commentator Louie Shum Chun-ying has died aged 66, according to his family and multiple local reports.

His twin sister confirmed on Sunday that he died on Saturday night at Ruttonjee Hospital in Wan Chai. A police source said he had a history of heart disease and diabetes. Shum had collapsed near a taxi rank and was taken to hospital.

Shum was chief executive of stock brokerage Sincere Securities until his retirement about two years ago. He was known for his market commentary and investment courses. His sister wrote that he had dedicated his life to Hong Kong’s financial and securities industry and mentored generations of students.

zh.headline: 資深股評人沈振盈逝世 享年66歲
zh.dek: 前訊匯證券行政總裁沈振盈（沈大師）周六晚在灣仔的士站附近暈倒，於律敦治醫院離世，家人周日證實。
body: 香港資深股市評論員沈振盈（人稱沈大師）逝世，享年66歲。
其胞妹周日證實，他於周六晚在灣仔律敦治醫院離世。警方消息指他有心臟病及糖尿病病史。沈振盈曾在的士站附近暈倒後送院。
沈振盈退休前擔任訊匯證券行政總裁，約兩年前退休。他長年在財經界發表市場評論及教授投資課程。其胞妹表示，他一生奉獻香港金融及證券業，並培育多代學生。
